CustomField.description: The query with host variable marker included. Query FROM Object must match the SObjectType of this record. For nested queries, use the parent object. Examples: Select Id, Name, RecordTypeId, RecordType.Name From Account Where Id in :keySet select id, subject, status from Case Where Id in :keySet SELECT (SELECT Id,parentId,commentBody,createdDate,SystemModStamp From CaseComments ORDER BY SystemModStamp DESC LIMIT 1) FROM Case Where Id IN: keySet
CustomField.label: QueryTemplate
